items.content:
Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
LEARNED CONTROLS (observed): WASD moves reliably—critical fallback when click-to-move stalls (clicks landing on a creature's hitbox absorb the click; spiders hugging the character blocked several flee clicks until D key worked). Left click interacts in two stages (walk, then pick) for distant sprites. Esc opens pause (Continue/Controls/Settings/Save&Quit); Esc again resumes—do NOT use Esc to close crafting. Number keys equip/light the hotbar slot's item (verified repeatedly: spare torch relit via slot key after 'My light just ran out!'). Pressing the same torch slot twice does NOT unequip; a lit torch burns continuously in daylight too, fuel unsavable. Crafting is mouse-only: with the panel open, D/W etc. move the character instead of navigating.

CRAFTING (observed, partly uncertain): Left category icons at x≈0.024; flame/light tab y≈0.155 opens a plaque column at x≈0.08–0.13. Row y-positions DRIFT between openings (torch row seen at ≈0.14, 0.46, 0.47, 0.48); the row bearing the lit-torch icon is the torch recipe. Click row CENTER (x≈0.105); clicking x≈0.128 falls through to the world and walks the character. Hovering alone shows nothing; success opening the recipe card is intermittent—sometimes first click works, sometimes repeated clicks do nothing (major time sink). Card shows have/need counts plus Build ≈(0.28,0.65) (grey when short). Build consumes 2 grass + 2 twigs; a new torch appears in hotbar (may auto-equip/auto-light). The card's have/need is the ONLY reliable inventory count—hotbar digit glyphs lie (an item showing '2' turned out not to be twigs; card read twig 0/2). Close the card by clicking the world; during spider attacks the card blocks left-side clicks and vision.

RESOURCES: Hover precisely on blade pixels; no tooltip = pointer off the sprite; sprites shift with camera every frame. 'Pick Grass' = tall golden spiky tuft; harvested stub reads 'Examine Grass'. Fresh vs stub is the key discriminator for grass and saplings. 'Pick Sapling' = thin bare twiggy bush → 1 twig; saplings also spawn on rocky patches and sand edges, not just forest. 'Pick Carrot' = brown spiky plant with orange base. 'Pick Berry Bush' = bush with red dots; harvested reads 'Examine Berry Bush'; regrows within roughly a game day (observed). Curved ground sticks are stumps (not pickups). Small pale pebbles often decorative. Mushrooms pickable (red/blue); 'Examine Blue Mushroom' on harvested. 'It's sleeping.' messages came from animals, not plants. Grass tufts sometimes offer a secondary 'Light' option—avoid.

DANGERS: Spiders (small brown/red) pursue relentlessly and bite; a white cone on a rock was a spider NEST with two spiders—avoid that rock entirely. Red antlered hounds hostile but often idle/asleep; carcasses inert/unharvestable. Clicking overlapping friendly creatures (cardinals, crows) can trigger 'Attack'—stop clicking there. Red vignette = taking damage (low health showed cracked heart). Darkness without light sometimes caused 'What was that?!'/'OW! Something hit me!' with vignette, but other nights passed quietly.

NAVIGATION/BIOMES: Spawn forest gets picked clean; fresh tufts/saplings cluster in unvisited turf and at biome edges. Savanna N/NE (golden turf, boulders, cardinals, rabbits); rocky bluff N (spider nest!); sandy dunes E; ocean far S. Trees intercept clicks—aim at sprites clear of trunks/canopies.

NIGHT SURVIVAL (learned): Survived Night 1 holding two torches (one burning ~100%, spare 97%) purely by waiting in place ~30+ waits; burn dropped ~2–4% per step; when the equipped torch died the character stayed lit (auto-equipped spare) and the game gave 'My light just ran out!'. Clock shows Day X with a dark phase in the middle; dusk warning 'It's getting late. It will be dark soon.' precedes it. Strategy: bank 2 grass + 2 twigs, craft spare(s) toward dusk (torches waste fuel if crafted early, but arriving at dusk unlit is worse), then wait out the dark with light; eat at first hunger warning (berries ≈1 each, carrots better).

UNRESOLVED/HYPOTHESES: why recipe cards open only sometimes (row drift? click age?); whether crafted torches auto-equip vs merely occupy a slot; exact night-damage conditions; mushroom edibility; logs/axe (flint) never yet obtained—Campfire (3 grass+2 logs) and Fire Pit (2 logs+12 rocks) remain blocked; purpose of petals, flowers, rabbits, fireflies (probably net-only), spider nest, petals; whether killing creatures yields loot; health regeneration rules; the 'S'-scroll plaques and Science tab; whether saving ('SAVING...' overlay) pauses input.
